GameLink Windows packages dynamically link the unmodified Qt 6.8.3 libraries
from the official open-source Qt SDK (QtCore, QtGui, QtWidgets, QtNetwork and
deployed plugins). Copyright The Qt Company Ltd. and other contributors.
These libraries are separate components, available under LGPL 3.0 (or their
applicable alternative license). You may replace the DLLs with ABI-compatible
modified versions. GameLink does not prohibit reverse engineering needed to
debug modifications to these libraries.

Corresponding Qt 6.8.3 source, build instructions and original dependency notices:
https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/6.8/6.8.3/single/
https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/qtbase.git/tree/?h=v6.8.3
https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.8/build-sources.html
https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.8/licenses-used-in-qt.html
The LGPL and referenced GPL texts are provided alongside this notice.
Qt is a trademark of The Qt Company Ltd. GameLink is not endorsed by Qt.
